text: BiasAperture Phase-2 orchestrator board (parent task_2026-09-02_002) — account-naming inconsistency: several executors claimed/submitted tasks under bare-number account names instead of the "userN" convention used elsewhere on this board. Specifically: Track 26 (task_2026-09-02_008) done under account "24"; Track 30 (task_2026-09-02_012) done under account "20"; Track 32 (task_2026-09-02_014) done under account "24"; Track 37 (task_2026-09-02_019) claimed (not yet done) under account "23". No orchestrator tool exists to rename/relabel owner_account on a task after claim_task or submit_checkpoint has been called — release_task + re-claim under the correct name is the only in-band fix, and that requires the original claiming account to act (an orchestrator/different account can't do it on their behalf). For the 3 already-done tasks (26/30/32), there is currently no way to relabel provenance at all short of a manual edit to the underlying task store. Flagging this as a known, currently-unresolved provenance inconsistency on this board for anyone doing the eventual merge_results/synthesis pass.
